(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (mem? cells r c)
    (find-first (lambda (p) (and (= (fst p) r) (= (snd p) c))) cells))
  (define (run-from cells r c dr dc)
    (let loop ((rr r) (cc c) (n 1))
      (if (mem? cells (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc))
          (loop (+ rr dr) (+ cc dc) (+ n 1))
          n)))
  ;; longest chain of cells stepping consistently in one diagonal direction
  (define (maxdiag cells)
    (apply max 1
      (flatmap (lambda (p)
        (map (lambda (d)
               (let ((dr (fst d)) (dc (snd d)))
                 (if (mem? cells (- (fst p) dr) (- (snd p) dc))
                     1
                     (run-from cells (fst p) (snd p) dr dc))))
             (list (list 1 1) (list 1 -1))))
        cells)))
  (foldl (lambda (obj acc)
           (let ((cells (obj-cells obj)))
             (if (>= (maxdiag cells) 3)
                 (recolor-cells acc cells 8)
                 acc)))
         g (objects-8 g 7))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (gray? r c)
    (and (<= 0 r) (< r (rows g)) (<= 0 c) (< c (cols g))
         (= (cell-at g r c) 5)))
  (define intermediate
    (map-grid g
      (lambda (r c value)
        (if (and (= value 7)
                 (or (and (gray? (- r 1) (- c 1))
                          (gray? (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))
                     (and (gray? (- r 1) (+ c 1))
                          (gray? (+ r 1) (- c 1)))))
            5 value))))
